[Benzinga news, 2026-10-21T18:02:26Z, by staff] Edwards Lifesciences Receives FDA Approval for Tricuspid Valve Repair System
Edwards Lifesciences has secured US FDA approval for its tricuspid valve repair system, marking a significant milestone for its structural heart disease portfolio.
The US Food and Drug Administration (FDA) has granted approval to Edwards Lifesciences for its tricuspid valve repair system. This regulatory milestone expands the company's treatment options for patients suffering from structural heart disease, specifically targeting tricuspid valve conditions. The approval represents a key development for the company's core business in transcatheter heart valve technologies. This new system is expected to strengthen the company's market position in the structural heart space.
